salaries = []
with open('employees.csv', mode='r') as file:
    lines = file.readlines()
    header = lines[0].strip().split(',')
    dept_idx = header.index('department')
    salary_idx = header.index('salary_usd')
    
    for line in lines[1:]:
        parts = line.strip().split(',')
        if parts[dept_idx] == 'Engineering':
            salaries.append(float(parts[salary_idx]))

if salaries:
    avg_salary = sum(salaries) / len(salaries)
    print(round(avg_salary))
else:
    print("No Engineering employees found.")
